statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-41568 is a docker cp symlink-swap race that can create empty host files. The upstream Moby advisory defines Docker Engine versions before 29.5.1 as affected and 29.5.1 as patched. This binary was built from the verified docker-v29.8.1 tag and therefore includes the fix. Scout identifies the compiled binary using its commit-derived Go version. See https://github.com/moby/moby/security/advisories/GHSA-vp62-88p7-qqf5

CVE-2026-33997 is an off-by-one error in plugin privilege validation. The upstream Moby advisory defines Docker Engine versions before 29.3.1 as affected and 29.3.1 as patched. This binary was built from the verified docker-v29.8.1 tag and therefore includes the fix. Scout identifies the compiled binary using its commit-derived Go version. See https://github.com/moby/moby/security/advisories/GHSA-pxq6-2prw-chj9

CVE-2026-42306 is a docker cp bind-mount race that allows a malicious container to redirect a mount destination to an arbitrary host path. The upstream Moby advisory defines Docker Engine versions before 29.5.1 as affected and 29.5.1 as patched. This binary was built from the verified docker-v29.8.1 tag and therefore includes the fix. Scout identifies the compiled binary using its commit-derived Go version. See https://github.com/moby/moby/security/advisories/GHSA-rg2x-37c3-w2rh

CVE-2026-41567 allows a malicious container image to execute a trojanized decompression binary with host daemon privileges when a compressed archive is uploaded to the container. The upstream Moby advisory defines Docker Engine versions before 29.5.1 as affected and 29.5.1 as patched. This binary was built from the verified docker-v29.8.1 tag and therefore includes the fix. Scout identifies the compiled binary using its commit-derived Go version. See https://github.com/moby/moby/security/advisories/GHSA-x86f-5xw2-fm2r

CVE-2026-34040 is an authorization-plugin bypass involving oversized API request bodies. The upstream Moby advisory defines Docker Engine versions before 29.3.1 as affected and 29.3.1 as patched. This binary was built from the verified docker-v29.8.1 tag and therefore includes the fix. Scout identifies the compiled binary using its commit-derived Go version. See https://github.com/moby/moby/security/advisories/GHSA-x744-4wpc-v9h2

The SBOM identifies the shipped Moby binary as commit 6a43e3d5afddf4111da0f864bbc7cae5d7e95001, the verified docker-v29.7.2 tag. The upstream Moby advisory https://github.com/moby/moby/security/advisories/GHSA-rg2x-37c3-w2rh identifies Docker Engine 29.5.1 as patched for CVE-2026-42306, so the vulnerable code is not present in 29.7.2.
